Item.Description: Declaration Validation (The declaration is currently within validation and is not yet accepted, registered or rejected. This code will be received for any initial linking of the declaration to the consignment on the inventory.). CHIEF Equivalent: 00

Declaration Goods Release (This status will be received once the declaration has a positive customs position but either control or the debt is provisional. However, the goods can be released. This will be received as part of a Declaration Status Notification.). CHIEF Equivalent: 01

Declaration Clearance (This status will be received once the declaration has a positive customs position and the control/debt is finalized. The majority of declaration will move to this status and skip release. This will be received as part of a Declaration Status Notification.). CHIEF Equivalent: 01
Declaration Invalidated (This status will be received as part of a Declaration Status Notification once the decision has been taken to invalidate the declaration. CHIEF Equivalent: 92/07/09/05
Declaration Rejected (If the declaration is rejected, then a Declaration Status Notification will be received with this code.). CHIEF Equivalent: N/A

Declaration Handled Externally (This status will be received as part of a Declaration Status Notification once the decision has been taken to take the declaration off system. This will happen extremely rarely, e.g. a declaration with 999 items receives a partial quota allocation.). CHIEF Equivalent: N/A

Declaration Correction Validation (The amendment for the declaration is currently within validation and is not yet registered or rejected. This code will be received for any initial linking of the ‘stand-in’ declaration to the consignment on the inventory.). CHIEF Equivalent: 22
Advance Declaration Registration. CHIEF Equivalent: N/A
Declaration Acceptance. CHIEF Equivalent: N/A
Declaration Acceptance at Goods Arrival. CHIEF Equivalent: N/A
Declaration Rejection at Goods Arrival (If the declaration fails re-validation at the point of arrival, then this notification will be sent to CSPs.). CHIEF Equivalent: R (export SOE)
Declaration Corrected. CHIEF Equivalent: N/A
Declaration Supplemented. CHIEF Equivalent: N/A
Declaration Risked (Notification that the declaration has now been risked and will contain a specific ROE code.). CHIEF Equivalent: N/A
Customs Position Determined. CHIEF Equivalent: N/A
Declaration Clearance after Goods Release. CHIEF Equivalent: N/A

Insufficient Guarantees (Will be sent as part of a Declaration Status Notification to inform of the need for the trader to take action on their deferment account. Suggests that there may be a delay to the declaration processing.). CHIEF Equivalent: N/A
Declaration Received (A declaration has been received and confirmed schema-valid by CDS.)
Provisional Customs Debt Calculated And Covered (Provisional customs debt has been calculated and coverage provided.)
Final Customs Debt Calculated AND Covered (Finalized customs debt has been calculated and coverage provided.)
Goods Exit Results Received (CDS has received the exit results of the goods consignment.)
Declaration Completed Successfully (All declaration processing has been successfully completed.)
Declaration Amended Due To Partial Or No Quota Allocation (The declaration has been amended as a result of partial or no quota allocation.)
